title: MotionJEPA: Preventing Temporal Feature Collapse by Capturing Visual Changes in Latent Space
abstract: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) are a promising paradigm for learning task-agnostic latent world models without visual reconstruction. However, standard JEPA training exhibits a strong inductive bias towards slow features, causing feature suppression and the collapse of latent representation. While inverse dynamics provides temporal anti-collapse, it relies on action labels and offers little incentive to embed general, unlabeled dynamics. We introduce Difference Image and Single image embedding Regularization (DISReg), a novel regularizer that builds on an inverse-dynamics-style module that predicts temporal difference image embeddings without any pixel reconstruction loss, encouraging balanced static and dynamic feature learning. DISReg consists of a static term that shapes the distribution of the image embedding and encourages slow features, and a dynamic term, which, unlike direct regularization on the embedding, imposes no constraint on the image embedding's shape or distribution and instead only incentivizes that dynamic features be present. By integrating this regularizer into a standard JEPA, we establish our new architecture, MotionJEPA. Latent probing demonstrates that MotionJEPA produces more complete representations than other methods, and our trajectory analysis shows it maintains geometrically simple latent embeddings with low curvature. We further show that MotionJEPA improves downstream planning success under static-background distractors across four environments.

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Welcome to Advanced Topics in Visual Representation Learning. Today's lecture is on a paper from researchers at the University of Oxford and vivo called 'MotionJEPA: Preventing Temporal Feature Collapse by Capturing Visual Changes in Latent Space'. We've seen a lot of work in the JEPA space recently, like 'LeWorldModel', which this paper builds on. The trend has been to learn world models without costly pixel reconstruction, but this introduces its own set of problems, particularly representational collapse. This paper tackles a specific, more subtle version of that problem. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 欢迎来到视觉表征学习进阶课。今天要讲的论文来自牛津大学和vivo的研究人员，题目是MotionJEPA：通过在潜空间中捕捉视觉变化来防止时序特征坍缩。最近JEPA方向出了不少工作，比如这篇论文所基于的LeWorldModel。趋势一直是在不做昂贵的像素重建的前提下学习世界模型，但这会带来它自己的一系列问题，尤其是表征坍缩。这篇论文要解决的正是这个问题中一个更具体、更隐蔽的版本。好，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor. Can you clarify what 'temporal feature collapse' is? Is it different from the usual representational collapse where everything maps to a single point?
segments.zh: 教授您好。您能解释一下什么是“时序特征坍缩”吗？它和通常说的表征坍缩——所有东西都映射到一个点上——是一回事吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That's an excellent question, and it's the core issue here. It is different. Complete collapse is when the encoder maps all inputs to nearly the same latent vector. Temporal feature collapse is more subtle. The latent space can still be diverse, but the model learns to ignore features that change quickly from one frame to the next. Imagine a video of a tennis match. A model with temporal collapse might learn a perfect representation of the court, the net, and the scoreboard, but completely ignore the fast-moving ball, because the ball's position is hard to predict. The model takes the easy way out and focuses only on static or slow-moving elements, which leads to a good prediction loss but a useless representation for many tasks.
segments.zh: 这是个很好的问题，也是这里的核心所在。它确实不一样。完全坍缩是指编码器把所有输入都映射到几乎同一个潜向量。而时序特征坍缩更微妙。潜空间仍然可以是多样的，但模型学会了忽略那些从一帧到下一帧快速变化的特征。想象一段网球比赛的视频。一个发生了时序坍缩的模型可能会学到球场、球网和记分牌的完美表示，但完全忽略快速移动的球，因为球的位置很难预测。模型选择了省事的做法，只关注静态或缓慢移动的元素，这带来了不错的预测损失，但对很多任务来说，学到的表示是没用的。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So it's a 'slow-feature bias'. The model prioritizes what's easy to predict. But don't existing methods like SIGReg or inverse dynamics solve this?
segments.zh: 所以这就是一种“慢特征偏好”。模型会优先选择容易预测的东西。但像SIGReg或逆动力学这样的现有方法不是能解决这个问题吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: They help, but they have their own limitations. A statistical regularizer like SIGReg can enforce overall variance in the latent space, but it doesn't guarantee that specific, fast-changing features are preserved. You can have a diverse representation of backgrounds and still miss the important dynamics. Inverse dynamics, where the model predicts the action that occurred between two states, is more targeted. However, it requires action labels, which aren't always available. More importantly, it only incentivizes the model to represent things the agent can directly control. It might ignore a falling object or other environmental dynamics that are critical to understand but not directly caused by an action. MotionJEPA aims to provide an action-independent signal to preserve these dynamics.
segments.zh: 这些方法确实有帮助，但各有各的局限。像SIGReg这样的统计正则化器可以约束潜空间的整体方差，但它并不能保证那些特定的、快速变化的特征被保留下来。你可能得到一个背景很多样的表征，却仍然漏掉了重要的动态。逆动力学——也就是让模型预测两个状态之间发生了什么动作——则更有针对性。但它需要动作标签，而动作标签并不总是有。更重要的是，它只激励模型去表征智能体能够直接控制的东西。它可能会忽略一个下落的物体，或者其他对环境动态至关重要的因素，而这些并不是由动作直接引起的。MotionJEPA的目标就是提供一种与动作无关的信号来保留这些动态。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The core contribution here is an objective they call DISReg, for Difference Image and Single image embedding Regularization. It works alongside the standard JEPA objective. The architecture is mostly standard: you have an image encoder that maps an observation to a latent vector, and a forward predictor that tries to predict the next latent vector. But during training, they add two extra components. First, a difference-image encoder takes the pixel-wise difference between two consecutive frames and encodes it into a 'difference embedding'. Second, a difference predictor takes the two corresponding image embeddings and tries to predict that difference embedding.
segments.zh: 这里的核心贡献是一个他们称为 DISReg 的目标函数，也就是差值图像与单图像嵌入正则化。它和标准的 JEPA 目标一起使用。架构基本是标准的：有一个图像编码器把观测映射成潜在向量，还有一个前向预测器尝试预测下一个潜在向量。但在训练过程中，他们额外加了两个组件。第一，一个差值图像编码器把两个连续帧之间的逐像素差值编码成一个“差值嵌入”。第二，一个差值预测器接收对应的两个图像嵌入，尝试预测那个差值嵌入。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Wait, so the main image embeddings for frames 't' and 't+1' have to contain enough information to reconstruct the embedding of the pixel difference between those frames?
segments.zh: 等等，那第t帧和第t+1帧的主图像嵌入，得包含足够的信息来重建这两帧之间像素差异的嵌入吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Exactly. This forces the image encoder to preserve information about what is changing visually. If it were to discard the position of the ball, for instance, it would be impossible for the difference predictor to succeed. This prediction task acts as a regularizer, ensuring dynamic information is encoded. These extra encoders are only used during training, so there's no inference overhead. They test this on a set of synthetic environments like Pong and Dino, where they can precisely measure which ground-truth state variables are being preserved by training probes on the frozen representations.
segments.zh: 没错。这就迫使图像编码器保留视觉上正在变化的信息。比如说，如果它把球的位置丢掉了，那差异预测器就不可能成功。这个预测任务起到正则化的作用，确保动态信息被编码进去。这些额外的编码器只在训练时使用，所以推理时没有额外开销。他们在一组合成环境上做了测试，比如Pong和Dino，在这些环境里可以精确测量哪些真实状态变量被保留了下来，方法是在冻结的表示上训练探针。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Using synthetic environments makes sense for that kind of analysis. But a simple frame difference seems like it would be very sensitive to noise or global camera motion. Did they address how this would work with more complex, real-world videos?
segments.zh: 用合成环境做这类分析确实合理。但简单的帧差法似乎对噪声或整体镜头运动非常敏感。他们有没有说明这在更复杂的真实视频里会怎么运作？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That's a key limitation they acknowledge. The experiments here are in controlled settings. In real robotics or natural videos, camera jitter, lighting changes, or complex background motion could create noisy difference images, potentially confusing the training signal. That's an area for future work. However, for their controlled experiments, the approach was highly effective. In their planning tasks, they added static wood-textured backgrounds as distractors. Standard LeWorldModel was distracted by the high-frequency texture and its planning performance plummeted. MotionJEPA, because it was forced to pay attention to change, largely ignored the static background and achieved significantly higher success rates.
segments.zh: 这是他们承认的一个关键局限。这里的实验都是在受控环境下做的。在真实的机器人场景或自然视频里，摄像头抖动、光照变化或者复杂的背景运动都可能产生带噪声的差分图像，进而干扰训练信号。这是未来工作的方向。不过在他们受控的实验里，这个方法非常有效。在规划任务中，他们加入了静态的木纹背景作为干扰项。标准的LeWorldModel被这种高频纹理干扰，规划性能大幅下降。而MotionJEPA因为被迫关注变化，基本上忽略了静态背景，成功率显著更高。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So it essentially learns to separate static and dynamic content. How does this connect to other ideas, like 'Temporal Straightening' for latent planning? That also tries to improve the geometry of latent trajectories.
segments.zh: 所以它本质上是在学习把静态和动态内容分开。那这和潜在规划里的“时间直线化”之类的思路有什么联系呢？那个方法也是想改善潜在轨迹的几何结构。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That's a great connection. They found that MotionJEPA does produce geometrically simpler, or 'straighter', latent trajectories for moving objects compared to methods that just apply a statistical regularizer across time. Those methods can sometimes create very curved, tangled paths. By focusing on predicting change, MotionJEPA naturally learns a space where simple visual changes, like an object moving in a straight line, correspond to simple paths in the latent space. It’s a different mechanism to achieve a similar geometric end. The key implication is that we need more targeted objectives than just 'predict the future' or 'maintain variance'. This paper provides a specific, action-free mechanism to force the model to represent change.
segments.zh: 这是个很好的联系。他们发现，相比那些只是在时间维度上施加统计正则化的方法，MotionJEPA确实能为运动物体生成几何上更简单、或者说更“直”的潜在轨迹。那些方法有时会产生非常弯曲、纠缠的路径。通过专注于预测变化，MotionJEPA自然地学到一个空间，其中简单的视觉变化——比如物体沿直线运动——对应着潜在空间中的简单路径。这是用不同的机制达到相似的几何目标。关键启示是，我们需要比“预测未来”或“保持方差”更有针对性的目标。这篇论文提供了一种具体的、不依赖动作的机制，来迫使模型表征变化。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: And they showed combining it with inverse dynamics was even better, which suggests the two approaches are capturing complementary information.
segments.zh: 他们还发现，把它和逆动力学结合起来效果更好，这说明这两种方法捕捉的是互补的信息。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Correct. Inverse dynamics ensures controllable features are represented, while DISReg ensures visually salient changes are represented, regardless of their cause. The two together provide more comprehensive coverage of the scene's dynamics. It’s a nice demonstration of how these different supervisory signals can be combined.
segments.zh: 没错。逆动力学确保可控特征被表示出来，而DISReg确保视觉上显著的变化被表示出来，不管这些变化的原因是什么。两者结合，就能更全面地覆盖场景中的动态变化。这也很好地展示了如何把这些不同的监督信号组合起来。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: So to wrap up, MotionJEPA addresses the subtle but critical problem of temporal feature collapse in predictive world models. By adding a simple training objective—predicting an embedding of the difference between frames—it forces the representation to account for dynamic elements in a scene, not just the static context. This leads to more balanced representations and more robust planning performance, especially in the presence of visual distractors. The main takeaway is that to build robust world models, it's not enough to predict the future state; you also have to explicitly account for the visual change that gets you there.
segments.zh: 总结一下，MotionJEPA解决的是预测型世界模型中一个微妙但关键的问题，即时间特征坍缩。它通过加入一个简单的训练目标，也就是预测帧间差异的嵌入，迫使表征去考虑场景中的动态元素，而不只是静态背景。这样一来，表征会更均衡，规划性能也更稳健，尤其是在存在视觉干扰的情况下。最核心的结论是，要构建稳健的世界模型，光预测未来状态还不够，你还必须显式地考虑把你带到那里的视觉变化。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 感谢收听。如果还有任何问题，可以问我们的人工智能助手，或者留言评论。
